definitions.explanation: In baseball, the number of official times a batter comes to the plate, excluding walks, sacrifices, and hit-by-pitches. The denominator used to calculate batting average.

examples.japanese: {四|よん}{打|だ}{数|すう}{二|に}{安打|あんだ}だった。
{打率|だりつ}は{安打数|あんだすう}を{打|だ}{数|すう}で{割|わ}って{求|もと}める。
examples.english: Batting average is found by dividing hits by at-bats.

examples.japanese: {今季|こんき}は{規定|きてい}{打|だ}{数|すう}に{達|たっ}して{首位打者|しゅいだしゃ}を{争|あらそ}っている。
examples.english: This season he has reached the required at-bats and is contending for the batting title.

notes:
A baseball statistic. Walks ({四球|しきゅう}), sacrifices, and hit-by-pitches are counted separately as plate appearances ({打席|だせき}) but not as {打|だ}{数|すう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {四|よん}{打|だ}{数|すう}{一|いち}{安打|あんだ}: one hit in four at-bats
- {規定|きてい}{打|だ}{数|すう}: the minimum at-bats to qualify for a title
- {無|む}{打|だ}{数|すう}: no official at-bats

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {打席|だせき}: plate appearance — every trip to the plate, including walks and sacrifices
